The 01/24 training config filters on deposition_date rather than release date, so this checkpoint probably does too. evidence: Foundry RF3 training configs (train_pn_unit.yaml and train_interface.yaml) filter on "deposition_date < '2024-01-01'". The README lists the Latest and Preprint checkpoints as 'Training Cutoff 01/24'.
notes: Exclusive cutoff on deposition date, so structures deposited on or after 2024-01-01 are excluded. Stage 3 fine-tuning extended the cutoff from 9/2021 to 1/2024, and the confidence head was retrained separately. The Arena id 'rf3_25' doesn't match the '01/24' name, and no RF3 checkpoint with a 2025 cutoff exists (only 01/24 Latest, 01/24 Preprint and 09/21 Benchmark). Which 01/24 checkpoint was run (Latest or Preprint) is unknown, but both have the same cutoff.
